mapper.select: SELECT id, company_id, industry_codes, region_codes, employee_count, annual_revenue, business_age_months, certifications, custom_attrs::text AS custom_attrs, last_updated_at FROM company_match_input WHERE company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO company_match_input ( company_id, industry_codes, region_codes, employee_count, annual_revenue, business_age_months, certifications, custom_attrs ) VALUES ( #{companyId}, #{industryCodes,typeHandler=kr.co.ircp.cms.domain.media.mapper.StringArrayTypeHandler,jdbcType=ARRAY}, #{regionCodes,typeHandler=kr.co.ircp.cms.domain.media.mapper.StringArrayTypeHandler,jdbcType=ARRAY}, #{employeeCount}, #{annualRevenue}, #{businessAgeMonths}, #{certifications,typeHandler=kr.co.ircp.cms.domain.media.mapper.StringArrayTypeHandler,jdbcType=ARRAY}, COALESCE(#{customAttrs}, '{}')::jsonb )
mapper.update: UPDATE company_match_input SET industry_codes = #{industryCodes,typeHandler=kr.co.ircp.cms.domain.media.mapper.StringArrayTypeHandler,jdbcType=ARRAY}, region_codes = #{regionCodes,typeHandler=kr.co.ircp.cms.domain.media.mapper.StringArrayTypeHandler,jdbcType=ARRAY}, employee_count = #{employeeCount}, annual_revenue = #{annualRevenue}, business_age_months = #{businessAgeMonths}, certifications = #{certifications,typeHandler=kr.co.ircp.cms.domain.media.mapper.StringArrayTypeHandler,jdbcType=ARRAY}, custom_attrs = COALESCE(#{customAttrs}, '{}')::jsonb, last_updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
